children: SailPoint reported fiscal second quarter results for the period ended July 31, 2026, showing total ARR of $1.231 billion, up 25% year-over-year, and total revenue of $309 million, up 17% year-over-year. The company delivered an adjusted diluted EPS of $0.09 and adjusted income from operations of $62.8 million (20.3% margin) for the quarter. SailPoint generated $45.0 million of cash from operating activities and $37.4 million of free cash flow in the quarter.
Total ARR: $1.231 billion, a 25% increase year-over-year.
Total revenue: $308.8 million, up 17% year-over-year; subscription revenue: $295.2 million (up 19% YoY).
Gross profit: $205.4 million; GAAP gross profit margin: 66.5% (adjusted gross profit: $239.1 million; adjusted gross margin: 77.4%).
GAAP loss from operations: $(59.0) million; adjusted income from operations: $62.8 million (adjusted operating margin 20.3%).
Net loss: $(50.4) million; adjusted diluted EPS: $0.09 for the quarter.
SaaS ARR grew 36% year-over-year to $847 million; net new SaaS ARR rose 34% YoY and accounted for 97% of net new ARR.
AI-driven ARR exceeded $70 million and AI-driven solutions represented more than 30% of net new ARR for the quarter.
Adopters of AI-driven solutions increased their quarterly annual spend by over 60%; more than two-thirds of completed migrations included an AI-driven solution.
SaaS customer count increased 16% year-over-year with ARR per SaaS customer up 17% to over $400,000.

Operational milestones: launched SailPoint Identity Security combining Agentic and Human Fabrics; released Cursor Enterprise connector; introduced Agentic Acceleration methodology; completed acquisition of Entro Security; launched Unified Platform Access and Claude Compliance API integration.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: SailPoint posts Q2 FY2027: ARR $1.231B (+25%), Revenue $309M, Adjusted EPS $0.09
